paper.citation: Hall, P. and Horowitz, J. (2013). A simple bootstrap method for constructing nonparametric confidence bands for functions. The Annals of Statistics, 41(4), 1892-1921. DOI: 10.1214/13-AOS1137.
paper.source_locator: arXiv:1309.4864v1, IMS electronic reprint (2013-09-19): section 2.1 equation (2.1), PDF p4; section 3.1 g1 and design/noise settings, PDF p13; section 3.2 Tables 1-3, PDF pp16-17, and discussion of x=0,+/-0.15,+/-0.3, PDF p21. mechanism.name: Hall--Horowitz Gaussian bump on a linear trend: pointwise regression-mean inference

generation_equations.label: Errors
generation_equations.expression: epsilon_i iid Normal(0,sigma^2), sigma in {1,0.5,0.2}; independent of X_i in the implementation.

generation_equations.label: Source g1
generation_equations.expression: g1(x)=x+5*phi(10*x)=x+5/sqrt(2*pi)*exp(-50*x^2). phi is the standard normal density, without an extra factor 10.

sampling.dependence: IID rows; independent X and epsilon within each row in the implementation. Fixed seed across query scenarios intentionally reuses the same sample.

assumptions: IID observation pairs (X,Y); fully observed covariate and outcome.
Declared product design: X uniform on [-1,1] independent of centered Gaussian epsilon; E[epsilon|X]=0 and Var(epsilon|X)=sigma^2.
Use the continuous conditional-mean version to define a value at a point under a continuous design. X has density 1/2 on its support.
The five registered query points lie in the interior and within the source evaluation region [-0.9,0.9].
No causal exchangeability assumptions are needed. The smooth regression function does not by itself establish CI validity for an arbitrary estimator.

properties.notes: Only X enters the mean. Nonlinearity comes from 5*phi(10X)=5/sqrt(2*pi)*exp(-50X^2), a smooth narrow bump on a linear trend. No multivariable interactions or irrelevant covariates. Var(Y|X)=sigma^2 is constant; three noise scales are scenarios, not distinct mechanisms. p=1 is low dimensional for the source n=100,200,400.

estimand.name: theta(x0)=g1(x0)
estimand.definition: Continuous conditional-mean version E[Y|X=x0]=x0+5*phi(10*x0) for a fixed query x0. Default x0=0; this is not a marginal mean or a future-response prediction target.

adaptations: Preserve the section 3.1 g1 equation, Uniform[-1,1] design and all three source error standard deviations; implement independent X and epsilon and IID pairs explicitly, consistent with the source model. The paragraph does not state the joint X-epsilon law separately.

Represent the source pointwise regression-function target by five scalar queries x=-0.3,-0.15,0,0.15,0.3. These locations are discussed in section 3.2 (electronic reprint p21); this finite query set is a contribution-level selection, not a claimed reconstruction of the full plotting grid.

Use Python random.Random (MT19937) with n uniform draws followed by n Gaussian draws. The original RNG, seed and exact draw order are not supplied in the inspected text; source simulation bitstreams are not reproduced.
Use n=128, seed=1729 for the guide check. Keep source n=100,200,400 and 1000 replications in metadata; do not reproduce the original estimator/coverage simulations.

Collect g1 as one mechanism. Do not repackage g2, already represented by nri-calonico-2018-asymmetric-sine-v1. Record g3 as the source-described truncation/rescaling of g2 and leave that related design uncollected in this one-new-mechanism contribution.
